messages:
alex_k: Ran the EdgeBurst POC stress window this morning — quick notes and blockers. Observed steady throughput near 980 RPS, p95 ~410ms, p99 ~620ms. Need sizing rec and answers for customer's security questionnaire before legal will sign. Link to raw results from perf-bot below.

maya_s: Nice, thanks. Can you paste the exact test command and model variant you used? Also what's the tokens distribution (avg / max)?

alex_k: Test used `ml-mixer-large` quantized int8. Avg prompt ~120 tokens, max 1024. k6 command: ```
 k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m script.js 
``` Headers include api-key, batching disabled (we wanted single-request latencies).

tony_p: For ~1k RPS with avg 120 tokens I'd recommend starting Dedicated at 6-8 A100-40G equiv GPUs with a small batching window (10-25ms) and KV cache warmup. If they accept model-variant fallback we can size lower. Also check sequence length distribution for kernel selection.

maya_s: Customer also flagged security items: KMS integration, audit log export to their SIEM, SOC2 report, and IP/data residency. Who owns these artifacts? @linda_m can you advise?

linda_m: I got this. We have SOC2 report link and KMS integration patterns. For hosted we support envelope encryption (bring-your-own-key) — they'll need to provide KMS ARN and allowlist our egress IPs or use VPC peering for Private. I'll attach checklist.

alex_k: Pricing question from the buyer — they want a ballpark monthly for an 8-GPU reserved pool + expected token cost. Also asking if we can commit to 99.9% latency SLO for the POC window.

maya_s: Ballpark for 8 A100-equivalent reserved capacity is ~$40k/mo pre-negotiation (depends on region & burst policy). Latency SLO: we can commit operational SLO during POC with canary + rollback, but enterprise SLA requires legal review. I'll capture as "operational SLO for evaluation" in the writeup. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Automated summary uploaded — run 2043219999: duration 10m, steady state 9:45-9:55, avg latency 230ms, p95 410ms, p99 622ms, throughput 980 RPS. Artifacts: https://redwood.test/results/edgeburst/2043219999 (logs + perf traces).

tony_p: If they can accept model fallback to a slightly smaller variant during peak, we can reduce committed GPUs to 6 and still meet p95 for most windows. I'll draft a simple runbook for canary -> scale -> fallback.

alex_k: Perfect. Next steps: maya to produce short POC writeup + cost estimate, tony to draft runbook and rollback playbook, linda to attach SOC2 + KMS instructions. Can we aim to hand this to the buyer by EOD?

maya_s: Yep — I'll assemble the one-pager and quote. tony, linda — can you drop your artifacts in this thread when ready?

linda_m: Will do, sending SOC2 link and KMS guide in 30m.

tony_p: Draft runbook uploaded to shared drive, will paste TL;DR here once I tighten it up.

alex_k: Thanks team. I'll follow up with legal for NDA addendum and capture any extra security Qs from the buyer. :pray:
